test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the questions. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of students who play different games. How many students play only one game?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd68fd5514ad3810060297fb52f470221726647a5450d427668938627ab433ce.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25e28422a8f9d92b517de2e4d43b969f08ecbab3b4809b4f39f73bb5c53e8ed2.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of students play only one game".

So, the total number of 'students play only one game' = 19 + 21 + 13 = 53.

Hence, the correct answer is "53".
